locator: Science Advances 2024, abstract and results; DOI 10.1126/sciadv.adj8275
summary: Analysis of 1,576 brand-audit events in 84 countries during 2018–2022 found 50% of collected items were unbranded. Among branded items, Nestlé accounted for 3% of the recorded count, placing it among the five largest brands in the dataset.
limitations: This is an observational citizen-science dataset, not a census of global plastic waste or total production. The denominator is branded items recorded in the audits.
